_comment: Ordered failure-classification rules. First match wins. Derived from 600 enriched failures sampled across 14 days on the IQVIA tenant (Sept 2026). Each rule matches on any of: exceptionType, exceptionLabel, a regex over details.why, or a regex over the raw message. Add new rules ABOVE 'upstream_cascade'; anything unmatched lands in 'unclassified' and is surfaced on the dashboard so the gap stays visible.

rules.title: Connection credential expired
rules.hint: The OAuth refresh token for the source connection is no longer valid. Reauthorize the connection in AAC.
rules.message_regex: invalid_grant|Unable to refresh access token|provided grant or refresh token is invalid

rules.title: Source/target permission denied
rules.hint: The connection's database user lacks privileges on the object. Check grants in the source system.
rules.why_regex: Insufficient privileges|SQL access control error|permission denied

rules.title: Dataset access lost
rules.hint: The job references a dataset the running user can no longer access. Re-share the dataset or fix ownership.

rules.title: Output schema mismatch
rules.hint: The recipe produces a different column count than the target table expects. Align the output or update the table.
rules.why_regex: Insert value list does not match column list

rules.title: SQL compilation error
rules.hint: The generated SQL was rejected by the target. Usually a type or identifier problem in the publish step.

rules.title: Unsupported schema operation
rules.hint: Schema management could not apply the required change to the target.

rules.title: Spark out of memory
rules.hint: The Databricks executor ran out of memory. Review partitioning or cluster sizing for this flow.

rules.title: Job exceeded maximum runtime
rules.hint: The job hit the platform runtime ceiling. Often an upstream hang rather than genuine long work.
rules.why_regex: not received during maximum runtime|timed out

rules.title: Compute quota exceeded
rules.hint: The workspace hit a compute quota. Concurrency or cluster limits need review.

rules.title: SSH tunnel failure
rules.hint: The SSH tunnel to the source host could not be established. Check the tunnel host and key configuration.

rules.title: Source connection timed out
rules.hint: The source system did not respond in time. Often transient; check source load if it repeats.

rules.title: Platform could not launch job
rules.hint: The platform failed to submit the job to its Kubernetes cluster. This is an AAC-side fault worth raising with Alteryx.
rules.why_regex: launching K8 job|submitting data-system job to kubernetes

rules.title: Recipe parse error
rules.hint: A step in the recipe could not be parsed or compiled. The flow needs editing.

rules.title: Databricks run failed
rules.hint: The Spark run failed on Databricks without a more specific cause. Pull the event log for detail.

rules.title: Transformation task failed
rules.hint: The transformation task failed inside the platform. Usually needs the AAC-side job id to investigate.

rules.title: Unresolved Datetime column type
rules.hint: A column is typed as the abstract 'Datetime' rather than a concrete format (e.g. yyyy-MM-dd), which the CDF compiler cannot resolve. Set an explicit datetime format on the offending column in the recipe.
rules.message_regex: Could not find leaf datetime type

rules.title: Connection pool exhausted
rules.hint: The platform timed out waiting for a JDBC connection from the pool. Usually source-side load or too much concurrency.
rules.message_regex: timed out while waiting to acquire a resource|BasicResourcePool

rules.title: Cannot connect to source database
rules.hint: The database refused or could not resolve the connection. Check host, service name and network path.
rules.message_regex: ORA-\d+|Could not connect to host|Cannot connect to database

rules.title: Storage read/write error
rules.hint: The job could not read or write the storage path. Check the container path and the credential behind it.

rules.title: Job terminated by the platform
rules.hint: The job sidecar received SIGTERM — the platform stopped the job rather than the job failing on its own.

rules.title: Planning stalled — no workload submitted
rules.hint: The planner never submitted a workload before giving up. An AAC-side fault worth raising with Alteryx.
rules.message_regex: Planning stale|Error creating jobs with JPL

rules.title: No error detail from platform
rules.hint: The job group failed but AAC attached no error message. Platform-side hiding or an incomplete record.

rules.title: Failed because an upstream job failed
rules.hint: Not a root cause — an earlier stage in the same job group failed. Look at that stage instead.

unclassified.title: Unclassified
unclassified.hint: No rule matched yet. Open a few of these and add a rule to error_rules.json.
